title: Extract all part types from Cursor stores with WAL-safe snapshots
description: Read SQLite through a safe snapshot; map composer messages and agent transcript entries to normalized parts with row provenance for SQLite. Done when: fixture extraction yields the expected parts and the source db is byte-identical afterwards.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Extraction maps bubbles into chapter-1 Messages in fullConversationHeadersOnly order (bubble keys b3,b1,b2 normalized to b1,b2,b3): type 1 -> User text, type 2 -> Assistant with thinking and toolFormerData -> ToolCall, toolResultBlob -> Blob part with blob_hash + container agentKv:blob. Changed composers re-detected by lastUpdatedAt (only composer-2 after the app bumps it). The hot WAL store is read exclusively through snapshot_sqlite snapshot copies - digest-verified never mutated, live app keeps writing. Full gate green.

right_now_summary: The team is building WAL-safe snapshots and normalized part extraction without altering the source database.
